segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שהי' רוצה שיהי' לו קיבוץ שלו בא"י איך וואלט גוואלט האבין מיינעם הקיבוץ אין ארץ ישראל.
segments.en: The well-known story of when Rabbainu wished to enter Breslov — at that time it was at the height of the controversy of the Elder [the Shpole Zeide]. For Rabbainu had then been in Zlatipola, where the controversy had taken place [as told in Chayay Moharan]. And he said that he suffered there two gehinnoms — for the judgment of the wicked in gehinnom is twelve months, and he was there twenty-four months. Then he traveled from Zlatipola to Tulchin to his uncle the holy Reb Baruch, requesting that he find him a rabbinical position in some nearby town. Reb Baruch replied that near Tulchin was the town of Breslov [a poor little town] — and it would be a place of rest for him. Reb Baruch immediately wrote to Breslov to send some distinguished townspeople to Tulchin to conclude arrangements with Rabbainu. They came — Reb Moshe Hinkes and Reb Avraham Feyges — and agreed with Rabbainu to give him a rendl per week for his sustenance.
